title: Smoked Slovakian Keto Sausage Bakes
description: A keto twist on traditional Slovakian sausage bakes, featuring long, smoked Slovakian sausages and a side of vanilla-flavored cauliflower.

ingredients.name: Cauliflower
ingredients.notes: vanilla flavoring and butter will be added later

instructions: 2. Cut the cauliflower into florets and place on a baking sheet.
3. Drizzle the cauliflower with butter and sprinkle with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
4. Roast the cauliflower in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
5. Meanwhile, slice the smoked Slovakian sausages into 1-inch pieces.
6. In a large skillet, cook the sausage pieces over medium-high heat until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
7. Remove the sausage from the skillet and set aside.
8. Add the vanilla extract to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
9. Sprinkle the bake into the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
10. Return the sausage to the skillet and stir to combine with the bake mixture.
11. Serve the sausage and bake mixture over the roasted cauliflower.
